title: AlphaSense Launches Next-Generation AI Agent SuperAnalyst to Power High-Value Financial and Strategic Workflows
key_facts: Always-on autonomous agent for financial and strategic workflows
Can research, analyze, reconcile evidence, calculate, write and run code
Produces investment memos, financial models, comparison tables, dashboards and board presentations that refresh on their own
Monitors assumptions behind a thesis and updates work without a new prompt
Built on AlphaSense's Context Graph and its content library, incl. 300,000 proprietary expert interviews
Customer quotes from Aberdeen Investments and Talos Eurisko Asset Management in the release
Used by organizations including Bank of America, J.P. Morgan and Pfizer, per the company
quote_evidence: Unlike static AI outputs and deliverables, SuperAnalyst keeps working after the initial analysis is complete.
Built for financial and corporate professionals making high-stakes decisions, SuperAnalyst enables users to delegate an objective, not manage a sequence of prompts and tools.
why_it_matters_hint: An agent for finance work that keeps updating its output, per the company.
notes: Company press release read at alpha-sense.com; no independent testing reported.
